title: This Mind Does Not Hold Still, Even
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 170
summary: This shabad opens with this mind does not hold still, even for an instant. Distracted by all sorts. It turns the heart toward for my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace.
whyItMatters: It matters when life feels scattered, unsettled, and wandering because the shabad keeps restlessness inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private momentum.
takeaway: Keep returning to this turn: For my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਦਹ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਹਾਢੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: eih manooaa khin na Tikai bahu ra(n)gee dheh dheh dhis chal chal haadde ||
lines.translation: This mind does not hold still, even for an instant. Distracted by all sorts of distractions, it wanders around aimlessly in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਠਾਢੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paiaa vaddabhaagee har ma(n)tr dheeaa man Thaadde ||1||
lines.translation: I have found the Perfect Guru, through great good fortune; He has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and my mind has become quiet and tranquil. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾਂਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam ham satigur laale kaa(n)dde ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Lord, I am the slave of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਾਗੁ ਦਗਾਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਢੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamarai masatak dhaag dhagaanaa ham karaj guroo bahu saadde ||
lines.translation: My forehead has been branded with His brand; I owe such a great debt to the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਭਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਢੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: paraupakaar pu(n)n bahu keeaa bhau dhutar taar paraadde ||2||
lines.translation: He has been so generous and kind to me; He has carried me across the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੂਰੇ ਗਾਢਨ ਗਾਢੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau preet ridhai har naahee tin koore gaaddan gaadde ||
lines.translation: Those who do not have love for the Lord within their hearts, harbor only false intentions and goals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਤਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਰਭਿ ਗਲਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiau paanee kaagadh binas jaat hai tiau manmukh garabh galaadde ||3||
lines.translation: As paper breaks down and dissolves in water, the self-willed manmukh wastes away in arrogant pride. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਠਾਢੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham jaaniaa kachhoo na jaaneh aagai jiau har raakhai tiau Thaadde ||
lines.translation: I know nothing, and I do not know the future; as the Lord keeps me, so do I stand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਤਰੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੧॥੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: ham bhool chook gur kirapaa dhaarahu jan naanak kutare kaadde ||4||7||21||59||
lines.translation: For my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace; servant Nanak is Your obedient dog. ||4||7||21||59||

structure: It opens by naming the condition without ornament: this mind does not hold still, even for an instant. Distracted by all sorts.
The middle movement widens the correction through he has carried me across the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean.
It closes with a return you can actually keep: for my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace.
